activities.activity_name: Migrate XD from 1.0 to 1.1 and port custom modules
activities.activity_description: Analyze changes between XD 1.0 and 1.1, update core APIs, migrate custom modules, ensure data pipeline operationalization, and test compatibility.

activities.activity_name: Enable building XD on Windows machine
activities.activity_description: Adapt build scripts, resolve platform-specific issues (path separators, native dependencies), compile and run unit tests on Windows, document setup instructions.

activities.activity_name: Set up Windows acceptance test environment and CI
activities.activity_description: Provision Windows EC2 instance, install required tools, configure test runner, execute existing acceptance tests, and create automated CI pipeline (e.g., Jenkins) for Windows builds.
Design and implement Spark Streaming data processors in XD using Java, Java Lambdas, and Scala; write unit tests and integration tests; document usage.

activities.activity_name: Update copyright in reference guide PDF
activities.activity_description: Locate copyright string in source files (e.g., AsciiDoc or XML), change year from 2014 to 2015, regenerate PDF using existing build tooling, and verify output.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade to Kafka SI GA release with backport
activities.activity_description: Backport existing XD-specific Kafka changes to Spring Integration Kafka module, then upgrade XD dependency to GA release, update configuration, and run integration tests.
